entries.source: the header of MPSMatrixRandom in the SDK of iOS 16.4, and the behaviour measured against the MPS of macOS 26.5 and the published Philox4x32-10 reference vectors (tests/backports/host/mpsmatrix)
entries.effect: the normal distribution draws mean + standardDeviation * invnorm(t) from the same t, with Wichura AS 241 in double precision: measured against the release over 160000 points spanning the whole range, 47.4% are bit for bit, 84.1% are within two units in the last place, and the largest absolute difference anywhere is 3.81e-06. The release uses a different rational approximation, which is in no header, so the two streams are not interchangeable; the uniform and the default distributions, and the raw UInt32 stream, are bit for bit
